name: Aku'mai
summary: At Blackfathom Deeps, Aku'mai haunts the sunken ruins of Elune's temple along the Zoram Strand. An Old God's corruption tainted the temple's sacred Moon Well, and Aku'mai rose from the waters as its servant. The Twilight's Hammer now sacrifices innocents to Aku'mai for power.

sections.title: The Scourge of Zoram Strand
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps was once a great temple of Elune, until an Old God's corruption tainted its sacred Moon Well. Aku'mai, a gargantuan hydra and servant of the Old God, rose from the waters. Now Aku'mai lairs in the submerged ruins of the night elves' fallen temple, a blight upon the Zoram Strand whose malice poisons the waters.

sections.title: Servant of the Primordial Darkness
sections.body: Aku'mai's presence drew the Twilight's Hammer into the subterranean caverns. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris and allied with the naga, the cultists occupy the drowned temple and sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for power.

aliases: what kind of monster is akumai
faq.answer: Aku'mai is an ancient, three-headed hydra that serves an Old God. Aku'mai rose from Blackfathom Deeps' tainted waters and lairs in the temple's submerged halls.
Aku'mai lives in the submerged grottos of Blackfathom Deeps, a ruined temple of Elune along the Zoram Strand in north-western Ashenvale.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer feeding Aku'mai?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer reveres Aku'mai as a servant of the Old Gods. Led by Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists sacrifice innocents to Aku'mai for dark power.
Aku'mai is immense, with multiple snapping heads, and carries the dark favor of the Old Gods. In battle, Aku'mai rages and engulfs those nearby in clouds of poison.
No. Aku'mai is a primordial hydra that serves an Old God. Its evil presence drew the Twilight's Hammer to worship around it.

faq.q: Why do adventurers venture into the deeps to slay it?
faq.answer: If left unchecked, Aku'mai's savagery and the cult's devotion threaten to unleash calamitous evil across Ashenvale and Kalimdor. Alliance and Horde authorities seek to end the Twilight's Hammer and slay the horror in the heart of the temple.

angles.text: Aku'mai has defiled the deepest sanctorum of a ruined temple once consecrated to Elune, turning a holy site into a lair of corruption.
Aku'mai and the Twilight's Hammer embody the Old Gods' corruption, set against the teachings of the Holy Light and Elune.
Aku'mai's unnatural corruption warps Ashenvale's coastal waters, which must be cleansed to restore natural balance.
